May 5, 2025

Dear Aisha Lindqvist,

Congratulations! This letter confirms our offer of a Headlamp Fellowship
through the DoD SkillBridge program, beginning June 9, 2025 and ending
approximately August 29, 2025 with duty at Keystone Fabrication Works.
They are located at 12 Foundry Lane, Altoona, PA 16601.

Your role will be a Welding Operations Fellow.

Duties & Responsibilities:
- Assist certified welders with fixture setup and fit-up checks
- Log weld inspection results on paper travelers
- Maintain consumables inventory at the assigned bay

Keystone Fabrication Works intends to extend their own offer of
employment to strong performers at the conclusion of the fellowship.

We are excited to have you aboard.

Sincerely,
